title: Queensland Brewery Company Building

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Queensland government elevation sample immediately outside the rounded main entry.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap address-tagged 501 Ann Street building envelope
mapIdentity.scope: Mapped OpenStreetMap way 236155563 carries 501 Ann Street and three storeys. The building outline identifies the rounded intersection with distinct street fronts and rear returns. Brisbane City Council confirms street address, heritage entry and aliases.

note: The 1940 contemporary design description and July 1942 archive photograph establish the buff brick, reinforced-concrete floors, horizontal window bands and curved entrance turret between angular piers. Written heritage and refurbishment records identify the retained mass, updated glazing and school adaptation.
